title: Range
summary: A slider, or with dual a minimum and maximum slider, drawn from tokens with a live value output.

props.name: dual
props.description: Two thumbs: a low and a high value; the low thumb never passes the high one.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: output
props.description: Shows the current value under the slider.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-range
events.detail: { value: number, low: number, high: number }
events.description: The user committed a value (single) or a pair (dual).

parts.name: control
parts.description: The single slider, or the low thumb.

cssProperties.name: --pk-range-fill
cssProperties.description: Colour of the filled track and the thumb.

cssProperties.name: --pk-range-track
cssProperties.default: a mix of muted and the input colour

a11y: Native range inputs: arrow keys, Home, End and Page keys; each thumb of a dual slider is named "<label> minimum" and "<label> maximum". The 44px phone hit area comes from the taller wrapper. A form receives one entry (single) or two entries under the same name (dual).

examples.title: Single and dual
examples.html:
<pk-range label="Volume" value="40" output></pk-range>
<pk-range label="Price range" dual value-low="20" value-high="80" output></pk-range>
